name: Social Auth Modal
description: Lets social login (Social Auth) happen inside a modal window instead of a full-page redirect.
project_description:
Social Auth Modal allows users to authenticate with social networks without leaving the current page.

 The authentication page is opened in a new modal window. After authentication is complete, the modal window is automatically closed, and the current page is reloaded to apply the authenticated session.

 This module is based on Social Auth and Social API projects.

 Version compatibility 
 2.x versions of this module are compatible with 4.x versions of Social Auth module.

 1.x versions of this module are compatible with 3.1.x versions of Social Auth module.
